Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent made a critical encoding/formatting error in its very first search query. Instead of searching for "Amélie release date first release 2001", it typed "Am�e9lie release date first release 2001". The character sequence "Am" followed by a null byte (or similar control character) and "e9lie" indicates a severe failure in handling special characters (the acute accent in 'é'). This malformed query resulted in irrelevant search results (about AM/PM time notation) instead of information about the film *Amélie*, causing the entire subsequent analysis to be based on incomplete and incorrect data regarding the first film's release date.
